messages:
Marc: Heads-up — planning a change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC to enable header routing and flip the runtime KV eviction tweak. Need API/Console/Runtime coordination and a pin/rollback plan. Window target ~20m.
Anya: @Marc can you paste rollback criteria? need to confirm pins for API and console.
Srijit: runtime note: we can toggle kv_eviction via the runtime flags endpoint. rollback is flip back + let KV drains settle (~8-12m).
Eve: Console: header rename might affect our parser fallback. We should run a console canary first and keep a parsing fallback for older headers.
Marc: Proposed plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic in eu-west with both header routing + kv_eviction=true for 10m. 2) If stable, ramp to 100% over 15m. 3) Auto-rollback if p95 latency >300ms or error rate >1% for the canary group. Manual rollback allowed anytime.
DeployBot: deploybot: scheduled deploy 'router-header-kv-2024-09' at 2024-09-15T02:00Z by Marc. Canary=5% eu-west. Status: queued.
Anya: I'll pin API routes to v1.4.3 for 1h post-rollout. @DeployBot please respect console_canary_green hold.
DeployBot: deploybot: hold set by Anya: hold-until=console_canary_green
Srijit: Quick config snippet for runtime flags:```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/runtime/flags \\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN\" \\n -d '{"kv_eviction": "on", "kv_draining": "fast"}'
```
Marc: Release notes draft: https://redwood-internal/relnotes/2024-09-15-router-kv.md (please add console note).
Eve: Console plan: deploy canary + verify with parser tests and the fallback header. We'll deploy console canary +5m after the router canary start.
Anya: Gate: set eval threshold — if embedding/tokenization diffs cause >0.5% regression on routing metrics, hold and roll back.
Srijit: Add runtime metrics to watch: kv_miss_ratio, kv_eviction_count (1m and 5m windows).
ops-bot: alert rule created: infra.alerts/ROLLBACK_ROUTER_HEADER — triggers on p95_latency>300ms OR error_rate>1% OR kv_eviction_count spike >500/min.
Marc: Pagers: @Eve console, @Srijit runtime, @Anya api, I'll own router.
Eve: noted. I'll post the canary dashboard link once live.
Anya: Also please add a small note in relnotes about changed config keys and a follow-up SDK PR for header parsing.
Srijit: rollback snippet:```
# rollback runtime flags
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/runtime/flags \\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN\" \\n -d '{"kv_eviction": "off", "kv_draining": "normal"}'
```
Marc: If canary shows 5xx spike or latency, rollback immediately. Otherwise proceed.
DeployBot: deploybot: canary started (simulation). status=canary_started ts=1759876590
Eve: Console canary green ✅ — parser logs look fine. dashboard: https://dash/reports/1234
Anya: API pin applied. Holding deploybot hold until console_canary_green.
DeployBot: deploybot: hold removed by Anya (console_canary_green). Proceeding to ramp.
ops-bot: ramp started to 100% at ts=1759876630; monitoring in place.
Marc: Done — header routing + kv_eviction flip rolled. No rollback required. I'll update the relnotes and close the window.
